name: Responsive Image Field
description: A field type for responsive images, allowing different images per breakpoint.
project_description:
The module provides a new field type that replaces the source images of the configured responsive image style for each breakpoint. 

 It enables the content editors to use handcrafted images for each breakpoint to fine-tune the image display on different devices. Responsive Image Field is based on the core Responsive Image module, extending its functionality.

 For more information, head to the README.md .

 

 

 

 Back to top 

 Features 
 

 
 Replacing images for individual breakpoints within one field. 
 No need to change the current image_style. 
 More control over images displayed at different breakpoints. 
 
 

 

 Back to top 

 Requirements 
 

 
 Responsive Image - core module.
